notes: createThread type: engine accepts 'public'|'private' (anything else = public); grammar's publicThread|privateThread makes privateThread silently public.
attachImage: grammar canvasName/fileName are wrong; engine reads imageName/imageSource.
editWebhook: avatar param is never read (only name, channelId, reason).
sendWebhook embeds: only title/description/color/footer; webhook color without '#' is parsed as hex (not decimal), unlike sendMessage which parses decimal.

sendMessage targetType also accepts reply (uses messageId), crosspost (channelId+messageId), typing; grammar only lists channel|user. Component V2 uses payload.componentV2 (not components) when messageMode=componentV2.

editChannelPermissions: engine ignores empty targetId only for everyone; supports permissions map {flag:'allow'|'deny'} taking precedence over allow/deny bitmasks. targetType 'user' aliased to member. editChannelPermissions also falls back to the current channel.
deleteChannelPermission: reason documented but not read. addThreadMember/removeThreadMember: channelId not read.
removeChannel reads channelId OR channelIds[] OR channelNames[] (names require guild); createChannel requires guild context.
createInvite/getInvite output key is inviteCode (grammar said code); getInvite returns only inviteCode/guildId/channelId/expiresAt (no stats).
getMessage exposes content, authorId, authorUsername, timestamp, messageId.
createChannel type also accepts forum; updateChannel also reads categoryId, slowmode, autoArchiveDuration, reason.
deleteMessages: results value is count; grammar 'messageCount' ok but 'count' alias, plus filterUsers/removePinned/beforeMessageId/deleteItself/reason/bdfdClear.

Unlike grammar, channelId is optional (falls back to current channel) for most message/reaction/pin/poll/thread actions; not for updateChannel/removeChannel/editMessage in practice (editMessage falls back too).

Engine reads some booleans via string compare 'true'/'1' after resolve (createInvite, createPoll, deleteMessages); editMessage clearEmbeds/clearComponents require literal boolean true; removeReaction removeOwn requires boolean true.
updateGuildOnboarding is unsupported: always returns an error.

updateAutoMod ignores ruleId/name/actions: it only upserts two fixed rules named 'BotCreator - Keyword Filter' and 'BotCreator - Mention Limit'; only ruleId is placeholder-resolved, the other fields are used as stored (unresolved).

createAutoModRule: eventType and triggerMetadata/actions[] are NOT read (event is always message_send); triggerType is a string enum, not a number; with actionType=send_alert_message and no alertChannelId the action list is empty.
moveToVoiceChannel reads targetChannelId (not channelId).
slowmode reads duration ('30', '10s', '5m'; max 6h), not seconds.
updateGuild does not read icon/banner; payload leave=true makes it leave the guild (that is how leaveGuild is implemented).
updateSelfUser reads avatarUrl/avatarBase64 (not avatar) and targetUserId; at least one of username/avatarUrl/avatarBase64 is required.

muteUser has no required duration: default 10 min; precedence durationSeconds > durationMinutes > durationHours > duration; 'until' (ISO datetime) overrides. memberId is accepted as alias of userId for muteUser/unmuteUser/addRole/removeRole/getMember.

addRole/removeRole also act as role-definition blocks (createNew/deleteRole/modify/updateColor/modifyPermissions/name/color/hoist/mentionable/position): in that mode userId is unused and roleId targets the role.

respondWithComponentV2/sendComponentV2: ephemeral is read from components.ephemeral, not a top-level key. sendComponentV2 in the native engine calls respondWithComponentV2Action, i.e. it RESPONDS to the interaction when one exists, channelId only used without interaction. components alias componentV2 accepted.

respondWithMessage rejects rich V2 components (only action rows with buttons/selects); returns status skipped_empty if nothing to send; ephemeral must be a real boolean true (not a string). Embed objects also accept fieldsTemplate, fields[].includeIf, author.author_icon_url and a legacy single 'embed' key (not described by the Embed type).

respondWithModal: payload may be wrapped in 'modal'; customId and title are required; needs at least one component (Label wrappers / textDisplay) or legacy inputs[]; onSubmitWorkflow/EntryPoint/Arguments are converted into an inline runWorkflow action; without inline actions no submit listener is registered.
editInteractionMessage: any non-empty components definition sets the V2 flag (32768) on the edit.
respondWithAutocomplete: items is a JSON array (or a template resolving to one), not a choices[] of {name,value}; requires an autocomplete interaction; stops the action list.
listenForButtonClick/SelectMenu/ModalSubmit require workflowName (no inline actions); only listenAndExecute accepts actions[]. arguments is an object of string values; ttlMinutes clamped 1-60.
listMembers/getMember only set results[key] (JSON string), no sub-keys.
Aucune de ces actions n'est 'unsupported' ; toutes sont gérées par handler.dart / le runner visuel natif.

Les scopes valides pour les variables sont guild|user|channel|guildMember|message (pas 'global' ni 'member' : une autre valeur lève une exception). Les variables globales passent par set/get/removeGlobalVariable.
setTemporaryVariable lit 'key' (pas 'name'). Les valeurs se saisissent via value, ou valueType + numberValue/boolValue/jsonValue ; 'element' est un alias de 'value'.
forLoop ne plafonne pas à 100 itérations ; seul le budget d'exécution limite. jsonForEachLoop ne lit ni array/itemVariable/actions.
randomChoice est dans Variables côté engine (variable_actions) mais catégorisé Logic dans la grammaire ; la sélection est modulo de l'horloge, sans poids.
unregisterGuildCommands avec commandNames vide supprime TOUTES les commandes du serveur.
Dans la sandbox, registerGuildCommands/unregisterGuildCommands/debugProfile sont simulés (résultat OK / 'Sandbox trace enabled').
httpRequest accepte HEAD ; saveJsonPathToGlobalVar a été retiré mais extractJsonPath existe.
runtimeImageBlock : width/height sont dans l'opération create ; les opérations ne sont pas des sous-actions Action[].

canvas*Block cannot run standalone; real engine input is runtimeImageBlock payload.operations=[{op,...}] (services/canvas_image_renderer.dart:108-226) plus imageName; editor nests {type,payload} then collapses via action_normalization.dart purgeActionPayloadStrict. Raw {type,payload} items reaching the renderer have no 'op' and are not drawn.

Grammar keys wrong: setMusicLoop reads 'loop' (not 'mode'), seekMusic reads 'position' (+positionUnit), not 'positionMs'; canvas keys differ (color not backgroundColor, x1/y1/x2/y2/thickness, fill, targetWidth/Height, no borderRadius/font/startX/lineWidth). playMusic/joinVoice channelId optional (falls back to author's voice channel via userId, auto-injected). Music blocks throw StateError without Lavalink service or guild; Lavalink failures never throw, they set results[key]='Error: ...'. String payload values are template-resolved.
Extra undocumented ops in drawText: textAlign, maxWidth; drawCircle/drawLine/drawRect accept blend (renderer-only, not in editor-collapsed ops).
